verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only API-based paths to get data out. The contacts API supports syncing contact data to other systems, custom object records can be retrieved in batches, the webhooks journal can retrieve historical data and CRM snapshots, and the MCP server gives read access to CRM data. A full exit would require scripting these yourself. The import-and-export knowledge-base page shown covers only imports. Missing for 10: a documented native bulk export of all data, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all object types, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful full exit.
